security_invariants: The launch URL contains only one opaque 32-byte bearer in the reviewed Form field alias; it contains no CRM ID, journey ID, name, email, phone, or company value.
Only a keyed digest of the bearer is persisted. Raw bearer values are never logged or stored.
Issue, prefill, and submission use different route secrets and exact POST-only paths.
The assisted submission contains no CRM record or journey identifier and resolves both exclusively from the durable token binding.
A tokenless public acknowledgment performs no assisted Data Store or CRM operation; the existing native public upsert remains the public writer.

rollback.first: unbind the CRM assisted launcher and both Zoho Forms server-side callers
rollback.then: disable the three exact Development routes or the Development API Gateway
